markers.name: Roam_V1
say: A human found on the surface!
markers.label: NPC 7020002

markers.name: Anis_V1
say: All right, I'm good to go!
markers.label: NPC 7020013

markers.name: Rapi_V1
say: This place is crawling with Raptures.
markers.label: NPC 7020010

markers.name: Anis_V2
say: Something like this came out of the lake?!
markers.label: NPC 7020013

markers.name: Com_V1
say: You can't trust anyone from the Ark.
markers.label: NPC 7020004

markers.name: Neon_V2
say:
It's a crazy catch, 
that's for sure...

But it feels a bit strange to say 
we "won" the match with this.
markers.label: NPC 7020017

markers.name: Rapi_V2
say: It looks like it's been in the lake for a long time.
markers.label: NPC 7020011

markers.name: Anis_V3
say: We found a robot trapped over there.
Looks like it knows something, but it's keeping its mouth shut.
markers.label: NPC 7020013

markers.name: Elegg_V1
say: That thing over there! Is it moving?!
markers.label: NPC 7020022

markers.name: Neon_V3
say: We discovered a severed Nikke arm!
And it was in a super dangerous lake filled with electricity!
markers.label: NPC 7020016

markers.name: Privaty_V1
say: Give me an update on the situation.
Let's plan out our next move.
markers.label: NPC 7020018

markers.name: Anis_V4
say: If you're that curious, just go on in and see for yourself.
markers.label: NPC 7020013

markers.name: Elegg_V2
say: Oh, my sweet Tetrapod, I've come back to you!
I missed you so, so much!
markers.label: NPC 7020023

markers.name: Neon_V4
say: I'm not exactly an expert when it comes to electricity.
markers.label: NPC 7020016

markers.name: Elegg_V3
say: Hehe, just a little more to go!
markers.label: NPC 7020023

markers.name: Privaty_V2
say: Ugh... I-I wasn't planning on saying I like you...
I hope you won't get the wrong idea, Commander!
markers.label: NPC 7020019

markers.name: Rapi_V4
say: Looks like you're not badly hurt, at least.
markers.label: NPC 7020012

markers.name: Rapunzel_V1
say: You don't need to worry anymore.
markers.label: NPC 7020028

markers.name: Elegg_V5
say: Whoa, check out all this machinery!
markers.label: NPC 7020022

markers.name: Hermin_V1
say: It's a pleasure to meet you.
markers.label: NPC 7020029

markers.name: Privaty_V4
say:
Emergency situation:
We found a survivor on the surface...
This should be enough for the report, right?
markers.label: NPC 7020018

markers.name: Rapi_V5
say: May I ask you a few questions?
markers.label: NPC 7020010

markers.name: Anis_V7
say: Either way, what we gotta do isn't gonna change.
markers.label: NPC 7020013

markers.name: Elegg_V6
say: Wow, Mr. Hermin is an incredible person!
markers.label: NPC 7020025

markers.name: Hermin_V2
say: There are materials stored in this device.
markers.label: NPC 7020030

markers.name: Privaty_V5
say: The things I need to do...
markers.label: NPC 7020021

markers.name: Anis_V8
say: So, you've finally made up your mind, huh?
All right, I'll give it my all to help you.
markers.label: NPC 7020013

markers.name: Elegg_V7
say: Lily and I will take a look at these storage terminals.
markers.label: NPC 7020022

markers.name: Neon_V7
say: Whatever it is, leave it to me!
markers.label: NPC 7020016

markers.name: Privaty_V6
say: Let's take this one step at a time.
... So I'm counting on all of you.
markers.label: NPC 7020018

markers.name: Roam_V7
say: I am good at moving things.
markers.label: NPC 7020001

markers.name: Elegg_V8
say: This one isn't in great condition.
markers.label: NPC 7020022

markers.name: Neon_V8
say: Should we block it with our bodies?
markers.label: NPC 7020016

markers.name: Privaty_V8
say: Prioritize moving the important items first!
markers.label: NPC 7020018

markers.name: Rapi_V8
say: How long do you think the backup will take?
markers.label: NPC 7020010

markers.name: Anis_V10
say: *Sigh* Of course, we're left to deal with the mess...
It's a shame that we didn't even get to see them off...
markers.label: NPC 7020014

markers.name: Neon_V9
say: Darn it, my firepower training session got cut short.
Yeah, we didn't even get to see them off properly.
markers.label: NPC 7020017

markers.name: Hongryeon_V1
say: Aye, I did snare a few.
But lo, all were consumed by Snow White's ravenous maw.
markers.label: NPC 7020027

markers.name: Anis_V11
say: Whoa! That surprised the heck out of me.
markers.label: NPC 7020013

markers.name: Neon_V12
say: As expected of Rapunzel! That firepower's insane!
markers.label: NPC 7020016

markers.name: Neon_V12
say: Snow White's belly... looks totally stuffed to the brim.
Oh, I gotta try some next time!
markers.label: NPC 7020016

markers.name: SnowWhite_V1
say: After eating the fish, I drank some water.
markers.label: NPC 7020026
